what: dispatch_queue.py REFUSES to fire an `accruing` or `underpowered` unit unless it declares run.inputs.research_unit, so the power verdict is stamped onto the rows the run lands. MEASURED 2026-09-22 by reading the workflow_dispatch inputs of e35-bracket-sweep.yml, m20-exit-lever-sweep.yml, pullback-frac-cross-leg-sweep.yml, research-exit-head-build.yml and regime-debt-matrix.yml: ONLY e35-bracket-sweep.yml declares research_unit (and power_state). The dispatcher's own note says `gh workflow run -f <undeclared-input>` ERRORS, so declaring it anyway fails at fire time while omitting it is refused at grade time. Net effect: an honestly-declared accruing unit can route to exactly ONE of the repo's ~20 research workflows. This is why RQ-20260922-003, -004 and -007 ship `blocked` rather than `queued`.
